newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia says to import 120,000 T Zimbabwean maize.
newsitem.headline: Zambia says to import 120,000 T Zimbabwean maize.

text.p: Zambia will import 120,000 tonnes of maize from neighbouring Zimbabwe to reduce a shortfall caused by a 32 percent drop in domestic production, the country's food reserve agency said on Tuesday.
Zambia had only 15,000 tonnes of maize stocks left, an agency spokesman said.
"The reserve agency has secured 120,000 tonnes of maize from Zimbabwe in an effort to meet an impending shortfall," the spokesman said.
He said all millers and commodity traders in the country which were interested in importing maize had been invited to a meeting on Tuesday afternoon to discuss details.
The agriculture ministry has forecast a maize deficit of around 272,000 tonnes this year after excessive rains and inadequate fertiliser stocks cut output in the previous season.
